items.title: Leadership Shuffle At Globant’s AI Unit (GLOB) Could Be A Game Changer For Its Service Mix
items.summary: Globant recently appointed long-time executive Fernando Matzkin as Chief Operating Officer and named former ServiceNow and AWS leader Sarab Narang as CEO of Glob.AI, its AI-native services business. These leadership moves come as Glob.AI reports roughly 60% quarterly annual recurring revenue growth and a US$436 million pipeline, underlining management’s focus on scaling enterprise AI services. items.summary: Wall Street has a consensus target for Palantir, and we think analysts are leaving real money on the table. Here is what the sovereign AI trade reveals that the Street's models keep missing.

items.title: Is It Worth Investing in ServiceNow (NOW) Based on Wall Street's Bullish Views?
items.summary: The average brokerage recommendation (ABR) for ServiceNow (NOW) is equivalent to a Buy. The overly optimistic recommendations of Wall Street analysts make the effectiveness of this highly sought-after metric questionable. So, is it worth buying the stock?

items.title: AI Isn’t Eating SaaS: Why Salesforce and ServiceNow Finally Exploded Upward
items.summary: Investors spent months betting that AI would cannibalize enterprise software giants, but Salesforce and ServiceNow just reported quarters that turned that fear inside out. The question now is whether these results signal a permanent reversal or just a temporary reprieve.

items.title: Is There Plenty of Room Left to Buy ServiceNow After It Spiked?
items.summary: ServiceNow just posted a 10% single-day surge on blockbuster AI numbers, but the stock still sits roughly 22% below last year's peak with its analyst target nearly in reach. Whether that combination signals a rare re-entry window or a value trap depends on one critical question about enterprise AI spending.
